source.title: Some open problems in geometric function theory

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 4152777.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/4152777 returned HTTP 403, but the zbMATH API resolved the exact record as A. W. Goodman's 1989 serial article 'Some open problems in geometric function theory', Zbl identifier 0703.30008, in Univalent functions, fractional calculus, and their applications, pages 49-64. The API record contained bibliographic metadata and a review but no full-text links.

Identifier-specific recovery found no DOI, arXiv identifier, publisher PDF, EuDML link, or repository link for the same exact work. Crossref title search did not return the Goodman 1989 article, and OpenAlex search returned unrelated or non-matching works rather than a confirmed same-title readable artifact.

Bounded exact-work web recovery used exact-title, exact-title plus PDF, and exact-title plus collection searches. Rejected candidates included a Scribd page because it exposed only a JavaScript client challenge to the page reader, later articles or references such as EuDML and Annales UMCS pages because they cite or discuss Goodman's work rather than reproduce the 1989 source, and a Research Problems in Function Theory page because it is a later secondary source, not the exact Goodman article.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, reviews, abstracts, search snippets, citation-only pages, or later secondary sources. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-4152777.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
